column1: # better-maps search evaluation set for Berlin (AP2b).
# Columns (tab separated): id, kind, query, expectation.
# kind: category|filter|typo_category -> expectation is a regex for the expected result types (classificator names);
#       cuisine|cuisine_filter -> expectation is a regex for any type of the result (e.g. cuisine-indian);
#       place|address|street|typo|collision -> expectation is a regex for the expected result ("name | address | type").
# Queries are run as typed in the app (no trailing space), see run_eval.sh.
